latin: Eadem pars rationalis, ut seipsam exiens, dicitur intellectus possibilis; ut vero est talis ut se ipsam ut possibilis est possit perficere, dicitur intellectus agens.
translation: The same rational part, insofar as it goes forth from itself, is called the possible intellect; but insofar as it is of such a kind that it can bring itself, as possible, to perfection, it is called the agent intellect.
